eyebrow: A LITTLE UNIVERSE, JUST FOR US
title: In every lifetime,
intro:
Two years. A thousand little moments.
And one person I’d choose all over again.
invitation: This is our story. Take your time.
dedication: For you. For us. For everything still to come.
closing: Not the end. Just another beautiful page.

chapters.label: The beginning
chapters.title: It started with a little hello.
chapters.whisper: Funny how a screen could feel so much like home.
paragraphs: Before you were part of my everyday, you were a name lighting up my screen. A message I hoped would come. A conversation I didn’t want to end.
Then came the late-night calls. The tiny pauses while a video caught up. The “are you still there?” when neither of us really wanted to say goodnight.
Somewhere between one more message and five more minutes, a stranger became my favourite part of the day.
chapters.note: One hello. A whole new world.

chapters.label: Knowing you
chapters.title: And then, all the little things.
chapters.whisper: I fell for the things you weren’t trying to show me.
paragraphs: The way your expression changes before you say what you’re thinking. Your very particular kind of funny. How an ordinary story becomes better when you’re the one telling it.
I began to know the small things: when to laugh with you, when to listen, when a little quiet was all you needed. And I’m still learning.
Two years later, there are still moments when you do something so completely you, and I catch myself smiling.

chapters.label: Life happened
chapters.title:
A little busier.
No less us.
chapters.kicker: 03 / EVEN WHEN THE WORLD GOT LOUD
chapters.whisper: The problem was never our love. Life simply became complicated.
paragraphs: Work asked for more. Studies filled the evenings. Family needed time, and some days there wasn’t much of us left to give.
Our conversations didn’t always stretch into the night anymore. Sometimes love was a short message between everything else. A thought saved for later. A quiet understanding.
You never have to measure your place in my life by how quickly a message arrives. We can make room for each other, gently, in the lives we’re still figuring out.
chapters.note: Even in the quiet, you matter.

chapters.label: Choosing you
chapters.title: You can just be you.
chapters.whisper: Because with you, I don’t have to be someone I’m not.
paragraphs: I love the version of you that feels strong enough for anything. I love the sensitive one, too. The tired one. The one who doesn’t have an answer yet.
You don’t have to arrive perfectly put together. There is room here for your unfinished thoughts, your silly side, your changing dreams. There is room for mine, too.
That is what I keep choosing. Not a perfect story. The ease of being ourselves, and the care we take with each other.

chapters.label: Always
chapters.title:
Still you.
Always you.
chapters.whisper: If I could begin again, I’d still begin with you.
paragraphs: From that first hello to all the little things I learned to love. Through full calendars and quieter evenings. Back to the simple, beautiful choice of us.
I don’t know every place life will take us. But I hope there are more ordinary mornings, more ridiculous conversations, more moments when we look at each other and just know.
Two years is a beautiful beginning. There is so much of our story still to come.
